correctness.rationale: Inspected RESULT.md blob ccc5754478f57ac14b04701742e3c81b1ca738f4 and verifier e9f63bf525c858b089dff7bca673ccd370d977f6. Unique mixed-radix sum representation supplies A_k×B_k partition of [0,Q_k). For n=dQ_k+u with top-digit parity in A, the excess A(n)B(n)-(n+1) equals β_k A_k(u)-(u+1), and vice versa for odd k. At u=Q_k-1 all lower pairs count; if u<Q_k-1 a pair with larger opposite coordinate gives a strictly extra count; k=0 handled separately. Equality therefore occurs precisely at the enumerated boundaries, and disjoint radix intervals give the exact count. Independent brute counts over seven mixed-radix lists matched, but the proof treats unbounded arbitrary radices.
